newsitem.title: USA: Essex Cty, N.J., weighs sale of waterworks--paper.
newsitem.headline: Essex Cty, N.J., weighs sale of waterworks--paper.

text.p: Essex County, N.J., is considering whether to sell its water system for $4 million to plug a hole in the county budget, the Star Ledger reported Tuesday.
County Executive James Treffinger, hoping to avoid a tax increase, proposed the sale of the water system serving a hospital center and a jail annex.
But county freeholders want to know if the system is worth more than $4 million, the newspaper said.
Essex County is facing a $10 million budget gap in the $426 million spending plan for fiscal 1998.
